On this channel I will be inviting you into my life as a Licensed Massage Therapist. I also will include information and tutorials on What is Massage Therapy, How to perform a Massage, Pros and Cons of a Massage Therapy Career, Benefits of Massage Therapy, and How to become a Massage Therapist.


A native of Nashville, TN, Patrick has found a second home in Birmingham, AL for the past 10 years. Graduating from the Birmingham School of Massage in 2009, Patrick has provided sports massage to UAB’s Track Team, Women's Softball Team and Football Team along with Samford University's Football Team. Patrick holds the belief that one should consistently take care of the mind and body. He is passionate about massage and believes that massage creates a balance of the mind and body. He consistently works to perfect his craft with certification in Connective Tissue and Neuromuscular therapy as well as Yoga and Physical fitness.
